greeting.headline: Ask me about my work.
greeting.subline: Pick a question below to get started.

composer.placeholder: Pick a question, or type / to filter
composer.notice: Predefined messages only for now. Pick one from the list.

who.label: About
who.answer: I'm Rafif, also known as Jeong. I'm a full-stack engineer who leans backend and ships AI-native products end to end, from schema to LLM-augmented UX. Right now I'm a Software Engineer at Mazecare, working remotely.

stack.label: Stack
stack.answer: Mostly TypeScript and Python, Next.js on the front end, PostgreSQL underneath, and Google Cloud for deployment. The full list is below.

certifications.label: Certifications
certifications.answer: Three: Google's Associate Cloud Engineer (2024), English for Business Communication from The British Institute (2024), and the ITS English EFL test (2021).

education.label: Education
education.answer: Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember in Surabaya. I earned a Bachelor of Informatics Engineering there, from September 2021 to September 2025, with a 3.48 GPA. I was a teaching assistant for five courses and reached the PIMNAS 36 finals with the Alpha Academy team.

experience.label: Experience
experience.answer: {roleCount} roles so far, most recently at {currentCompany}. I have opened the timeline; pick any role below for the details.

now.label: Now
now.prompt: What are you doing right now?
now.answer: I'm a Software Engineer at Mazecare, a healthcare technology company in Hong Kong building clinical and patient-facing software. I joined in August 2026 and build product features across the whole stack.

role.label: {company}
role.answer: {company}, {period}. My role there: {role}. Here is what I shipped.

work.label: Work
work.answer: {projectCount} projects I am happy to show, from a Claude Code plugin to a headless CMS and on-chain contracts.

recentProject.label: Latest project
recentProject.prompt: Show me your most recent project

openSource.label: Open source
openSource.answer: Yes. {openSourceCount} of my projects have public repositories on GitHub. They're listed below with links.

writing.label: Blog
writing.answer: {postCount} posts so far. Mostly engineering write-ups of things I built, with some design and web3.

thisSite.label: This site
thisSite.prompt: How did you build this site?
thisSite.answer: Next.js, GSAP and a hand-written canvas globe, in a Japanese brutalist style. I wrote up the architecture in “Building This Portfolio”.

changelog.label: Changelog
changelog.answer: {commitCount} commits since launch. The latest was “{latestCommit}”.
changelog.answerFallback: Every commit to this site, grouped by month.

ratecard.label: Ratecard
ratecard.prompt: How much would my project cost?
ratecard.answer: It depends on scope. Paste your brief into the estimator and answer a few questions; you'll get a complexity score and a fee range in IDR and USD.

booking.label: Book a call
booking.answer: Yes. Pick a slot and it lands straight in my calendar. It can be project scoping, a technical review, or just a conversation.

pay.label: Pay
pay.answer: Two ways: QRIS if you're in Indonesia, or Ethereum mainnet. Both are direct transfers, so message me once you've sent it.

cv.label: CV
cv.answer: Here it is. The PDF is downloading now.

contact.answer: Email is fastest: {email}. I'm also on GitHub and LinkedIn.
